purpose: Portable, source-bound automated browser qualification for the operational workspace changes; not a usability study.

source_integrity.verification: The functional binary commit equals the functional source commit. Relevant source JS, CSS and HTML, and test/helper sources were hashed before the functional run and verified again after that run. The separate capture_followup records its exact opt-in harness revision and verifies that every served production asset still equals the qualified functional source.

coverage: Isolated actual WOS API journeys cover progressive planning, Task specification, documentary notes, criterion-specific Evidence, independent assessment, explicit acceptance and restart/second-client persistence.
Real before/after movement, inherited blocking, stale scope rejection, parent conclusion impact, and atomic Issue/Blocker scope previews are exercised through visible controls.
Signed profiles, current lease authority, immutable receipts/history, explicit revocation, contextual operations and uncertain intent recovery retain their semantic checks.
Keyboard navigation, focus restoration, async readiness/late response fences, bounded paging, accessible controls and retained specialist views are exercised.
Responsive geometry includes HD, QHD, 4K and 320/390/430px viewports; native browser zoom 125/150/200% preserves a 1366x768 framebuffer. Individual cases specify their exact matrix.
The suite also contains isolated renderer/form/reference-picker fixtures; those tests prove component behavior and are not presented as real backend acceptance.
earlier_failures_and_resolution: Earlier qualification runs exposed real async readiness, native Escape, long-record hydration, stale preparation and compact inspector readability defects; fixes were included before this final run.

Older selectors assumed retired inspector/menu structures or intercepted the legacy context route; they were updated to use current visible controls and typed workspace reads while retaining authority and history assertions.
A component fixture used a moving wall-clock pause target; a fixed installed time and a future pause removed the backwards-clock race without changing debounce/abort assertions.

The first source-bound gallery exposed an actual nested Task reading gap at 320/390px. Whole-inspector mobile scrolling, compact full-name context controls and bounded detail-header spacing were added, with new initial-prose/action/return regressions at 320/390/430px. Historical before images remain linked separately.

A delayed failed conclusion-impact read is fenced after closing the form and selecting another Task; its regression retains the new route, focus and notice while current graph errors settle independently.
An initial conclusion test assumed native required checkbox validation. It now verifies the real guard: an unchecked submission displays the review requirement and dispatches no achievement command.
limitations: This evidence is automated and source-bound. No participant usability study or product-owner acceptance is claimed.
Only Chromium was run; Firefox and Safari were not qualified in this run.
Browser runtime journeys use isolated local SQLite instances. PostgreSQL, race, process-death, migration and performance qualification are documented separately.
Loaded graph/preview limits remain explicit; these tests do not prove an unbounded graph, cloud fleet throughput or production deployment readiness.
The opt-in screenshot gallery is excluded from the functional test total and has its own source-bound records and visual review.

capture_history.visual_review_note: The root visual review found that the nested Task inspector at 390px leaves no authored prose visible at its initial scroll position. Existing three-line density assertions covered Evidence. This capture is retained as provenance; it is not claimed as final visual acceptance.

capture_history.note: After Escape correctly returned focus to the mobile Task action-menu trigger, the capture helper asserted that Close was onscreen before focusing it. The opt-in helper was corrected to focus Close first, then retain actual focus, pointer hit-testing, scroll-top and initial-prose checks. The 164 passing functional cases are unaffected. Partial artifacts and the failed job report were preserved outside the repository for diagnosis.

visual_review.method: Primary-agent inspection of actual generated PNG files; separate from automated geometry and independent participant acceptance.
visual_review.observations: Corrected initial mobile Task prose, compact named context controls, grouped actions, separated move labels, stable desktop sizing and reachable scrolling inspector controls are visible. Native 200% uses the bounded whole-inspector scroller; content beyond its initial viewport requires scrolling. This representative review does not claim all-image human acceptance, other engines, a mobile software keyboard or participant comprehension.
